metadata.title: On deformations of foliated complex analytic structures II: Functors of Artin rings
metadata.abstract: We study deformations of foliated nonsingular varieties defined by locally free subsheaves of tangent sheaves and locally free subshseaves of cotangent sheaves in the language of functors of Artin rings. We identify first-order deformations and obstructions.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 叶状复结构的 Artin 环变形
analysis.workSummary: 在 Artin 环函子语言中研究切丛或余切丛局部自由子层定义的叶状非奇异簇变形，识别一阶变形及阻碍。
analysis.breakthrough: 为两类叶状结构给出统一无穷小变形框架。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出具体控制复形和消失准则，不能据此断言任意叶状变形均可延拓。
